description.value: Taco Bell on Harvey Avenue is a Tex-Mex fast-food chain restaurant serving tacos, burritos, Crunchwrap Supremes, and other familiar menu staples with dine-in and takeout available. A dedicated Veggie Cravings Menu offers vegetarian options such as the Cheesy Bean and Rice Burrito. Situated on Kelowna's main commercial corridor, it is a convenient and affordable calorie stop for cyclists moving through the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address (2271 Harvey Avenue, Kelowna BC, V1Y 6H2) and phone ((250) 860-3338) match OSM exactly. The site explicitly mentions dine-in, takeout, and a Veggie Cravings Menu with vegetarian items. No evidence is present for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities beyond what OSM tags provide.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant confirmed open by a functioning location-specific website page.
